content.value: Let $f ( z )$ be analytic in a region R bounded by two simple closed curves $c _ { 1 }$ and $c _ { 2 }$ Then prove that $\oint _ { c _ { 1 } } f ( z ) d z = \oint _ { c _ { 2 } } f ( z ) d z$ , where $c _ { 1 }$ and $c _ { 2 }$ are both traversed in the positive sense relative to their interiors.
